_about: Where every result file comes from: the commit the Kaggle kernel checked out (kaggle/push.py pins it), the software and hardware it ran on, and the data. Collected from the kernel logs. Local steps (evaluate, crossval, report) run on CPU in the pixi environment pinned by pixi.lock.

data.dataset: KITTI tracking, training split (21 sequences, 8,008 frames), camera 2 images
data.images: Kaggle dataset leducnhuan/kitti-tracking, version 1 (last updated 2023-11-10); its Kaggle page lists the license as unknown, the original KITTI license is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0
data.labels_and_calibration: data/kitti_tracking/training/{label_02,calib}, copied unchanged from the same dataset

kaggle_environment.hardware: NVIDIA Tesla T4 x2 (one used per kernel), Intel Xeon CPU @ 2.00GHz, 4 vCPU
kaggle_environment.weights: yolo26n.pt from the Ultralytics v8.4.0 assets release (COCO)

local_environment.note: CPU only; exact versions in pixi.lock

results/finetune.content: fine-tuning curve and arguments of the fixed-split model (release v0.1)

results/det/coco_1280, ft_1280, ft_1280_.content: detections on all 21 sequences; coco_1280 is also the baseline of the cross-validation

results/det/ft_1280_nms_trt16.kernel: spritker/monodist-eval (mode full, detection of this configuration only)

results/latency.content: every timing and the GPU profile, all from one session, with the fixed-split weights

results/cv/det, results/cv/train.content: only the kept configurations are tracked; all of them and the fold weights are in release v0.2

results/eval, results/cv/*.json, results.produced_by: python -m monodist.evaluate, python -m monodist.crossval, python -m monodist.report on the local CPU environment

note_on_commits: The detections come from four commits (7f9160f, 9810fc2, e4a3739, 544b7e5); with the fixed-split fine-tuning (0cd8444) the results span five. Between them monodist/detect.py only gained the --nms option (default unchanged) and an explicit class filter [0, 1] that selects the same classes as before for two-class models, so each configuration's detection path behaves the same; a clean rerun at one commit was offered and declined on 2026-09-30 for lack of Kaggle quota.
